authorityComparison.method: The locked vendored artifacts are verified byte-for-byte against the published authority CDN recorded in vendor.lock.json, and the committed op bundle is identified by SHA-256.

compatDeclaration.note: The declaration is narrowed to the tested authority scope: compat.mode "list" with the explicit 209 effect IDs the recorded rendered parity qualifies (210 catalog ids minus the compile-only filter/octaveWarp). tools/compat-gate.mjs rejects any declaration claiming more before delivery, with negative identity controls in test/compat-gate.test.js. The earlier exact-source kit-publication blocker is cleared (2026-09-30): kit 0.1.31 at source 7615588 is published and verified (17/17 inventory files, list declaration served; see GAP-006), so the served compat declaration matches this repo's narrowed scope.
